'''Yannick Lapointe 667 jesus deck v2''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech. The post says the deck is "16 and 1" in tournaments, including "in world 3 and 1 but without epp and ejp" (likely the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]); that version differed from this list, so it is filed as a general deck.<ref name="dt-3037">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3037 667 jesus deck v2], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 7 February 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3037/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3037/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018205104/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3037/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''667 jesus deck v2'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' February 7, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' this is the same deck i just change the title(666 SATAN deck)

=== Strategy ===

this deck in tourney( not only in my region, in world 3 and 1 but without epp and ejp) is 16 and 1 and most of is win is against x-wing swarm if you dont understand it just play with your main and toys but this deck is one of the best dark side i ever saw
